publicEvidenceClass: sanitized transcription of a dedicated-account live run
rawDirectoryMeaning: Earliest public-safe observations, not byte-for-byte Azure logs
privateSourceRetention: Exact commands, probe outputs, management reads, and identifiers are retained outside this public repository
publicVerificationBoundary: Repository hashes and evaluators prove internal consistency and change detection; they do not independently authenticate the withheld source
hashCanonicalization: SHA-256 uses UTF-8 text normalized to LF; binary assets use raw bytes
observationTimeBasis: observedAtUtc comes from the probe output or post-test management read, not a service-side request timestamp
liveRunSequence: authenticated public request returned a Chat Completions HTTP 200 while PNA was Enabled
private-IP ACI returned a Chat Completions HTTP 200 while PNA was Enabled
authenticated public request blocked while PNA was Disabled
the same private-IP ACI code path returned a Chat Completions HTTP 200 while PNA was Disabled
authenticated public request returned HTTP 200 after PNA was restored
privateRunner: Private-IP Azure Container Instances in a linked VNet workload subnet; not Azure Bastion
sourceContinuity: All five observations carry identical probe-source, Entra-subject, endpoint, deployment, and serialized-request SHA-256 fingerprints
postRunHardening: The current probe adds native fingerprints, the ACI launcher is create-only, and PNA restore uses ETag preconditions. connectivity-run.json separately hashes the current executable files.
fieldRetentionBoundary: Successful probes retain DNS class, HTTP status, response object, model, choice count, usage, and request-ID digest; completion text and resolved IP addresses are omitted
postTestBoundary: PNA was restored and both ACI probes terminated with exit code 0. Dedicated resources remain, cleanup is awaiting explicit user authorization, and Managed Compute billing continues.
